familyTheme: Parallel parameter evaluation and batch optimization tasks spanning Mars analysis, rover routing, habitat controls, and alert calibration.

derivedTasks.title: Similar - Mars Sweep Frontier
derivedTasks.goal: Evaluate a full Mars scoring grid and export the Pareto frontier of F1-versus-delta trade-offs.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task requires evaluating dozens of parameter combinations independently, making multi-core batch execution substantially faster and less error-prone than manual sequential runs.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Rover Route Batch Ranking
derivedTasks.goal: Evaluate all candidate inspection policies and write the top-ranked configurations into a deterministic CSV.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Each policy can be scored independently across route records, so parallel execution is the natural way to scale the exhaustive search.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Habitat Zone Plan
derivedTasks.goal: Select the best control policy for each habitat zone and export a JSON plan with aggregate summary metrics.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Per-zone policy search is embarrassingly parallel and benefits from concise parallel map-style computation across independent zones.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Alert Calibration Matrix
derivedTasks.goal: Score all alert threshold combinations on historical events and output a Pareto-optimal calibration matrix.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Independent threshold simulations over many configurations are ideal for parallel batch processing and reproducible grid evaluation.
